notes.title: Finding America: New England - Now Available!
notes.content:
Unearth the wonders of New England in a game that combines history, adventure, and hidden object challenges. 'Finding America: New England' takes you on an unforgettable journey. Seek out hidden objects amidst stunning scenery and unlock the stories of America's colonial past. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717094/056ecaf4c7b3f023eb30f1ea91756fe9260dc46f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44717094/76f2e875a74b6e56ba9ee0b7fa9ca62267845174.gif[/img]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Behold the sights of New England, all done in a Hidden Object style.
[*]Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to New England!
[*]Pick up fun facts about the region!
[*]Comes with wallpapers and a full soundtrack.
[*]Maximize your vacation with Unlimited Mode!
[/list]

[h2]Collectors Edition[/h2]
[list]
[*]12 more chapters
[*]6 CE-exclusive Hidden Object scenes!
[/list]

Enjoy one stunning chapter after another and experience all that New England has in store in this all-American Hidden Object game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2589350/Finding_America_New_England/

notes.title: Finding America: The West - Now Available!
notes.content:
"Finding America: The West" is now available on Steam! Immerse yourself in the rich history and culture of the Western United States as you embark on a journey to discover its hidden treasures in this latest installment to the Finding America franchise.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086018/3379b0aa8ea0f0a9c6934e6e9f01ce2265cb5d5c.gif[/img]

Dive into the world of hidden objects and uncover the wonders of the West, from the majestic peaks of Yosemite National Park to the breathtaking beauty of the Grand Canyon. Wander through the iconic Santa Monica Pier and soak up the vibrant atmosphere that makes the West so special.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44086018/2e315b3ad30419b4a1c3c8d58b5311ae96641594.gif[/img]

To celebrate the launch, we're offering a generous 20% weeklong discount on Finding America: The West. Grab your copy now and embark on this unforgettable adventure at a special price. Don't miss out on this incredible opportunity to experience the magic of the West for less!

Enjoy the game and happy exploring!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767140/Finding_America_The_West/

notes.title: Finding America: The Pacific Northwest is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Play over 30 fun minigames, all connected to the Pacific Northwest!
[*] Pick up fun facts about the region!
[*] Comes with wallpapers and a full soundtrack.
[*] Maximize your vacation with Unlimited Mode!
[/list]

Enjoy one stunning chapter after another and experience all that the Pacific Northwest has in store in this all-American Hidden Object game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2221620/Finding_America_The_Pacific_Northwest/

notes.title: Finding America: The Heartland is NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
Introducing the first game of a brand new, all-American Hidden Object series: Finding America: The Heartland! From Kansas’ simple farmhouses to South Dakota’s grand Mount Rushmore, experience the many things the Heartland has to offer — in stunning Hidden Object and mini game form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685512/55a7a26a8e8f57fe63cd144a28659fc226f10f30.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685512/ca6c5bb906723ff470d61af97d0f1ebd2e28cb37.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42685512/21c43fada2d77501e8ca680dd86838107fd85f3e.png[/img]

Complete each chapter, unlock tons of different trivia, and enjoy everything the Heartland has to offer in this all-American Hidden Object game!
